messages.content: [2026 Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia] The 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia (officially known as the Formula 1 Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia 2026) was a Formula One motor race held on 4 October 2026 at the Sepang International Circuit in Sepang, Selangor, Malaysia. It was the sixteenth round of the 2026 Formula One World Championship and the first Formula One race at Sepang since 2017. The race was originally scheduled as the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix and was set to be held at the Bahrain International Circuit on 12 April; the outbreak of the 2026 Iran war prevented the race from taking place as scheduled. Following an agreement between Formula One, the Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile (FIA), Bahrain, and Malaysia, the event was reinstated on the calendar and relocated to Sepang, retaining the Bahrain Grand Prix name. Bahrain retained control over ticket pricing and the right to receive all proceeds from the race. Max Verstappen (Red Bull) secured his first pole position of the season. Lewis Hamilton (Ferrari) qualified second, ahead of Verstappen's teammate Isack Hadjar. Hadjar's five-place grid penalty for exceeding his allocation of power unit elements relegated him to eighth on the starting grid. This promoted championship leader Kimi Antonelli (Mercedes) to third, alongside Charles Leclerc (Ferrari) on the second row. Heavy rain delayed the start by 40 minutes. Technical problems during the formation laps then forced the starting procedure to be suspended.
